per_layer_body_cap: the declared compressed size of that exact digest
non_layer_cap_evidence: HISTORICAL_OBSERVATION from the D.29 comparison value and the D.24-R2 config-retrieval cap
non_layer_count_meaning: A ceiling, not a prediction that this many non-layer bodies will arrive.
cumulative_formula: unique blob bytes plus non-layer ceiling times 1048576
counting_rules: Stream every body through a counter.
Count challenge, token, redirect, and error bodies.
Count bytes even when a later hash check fails.
Do not trust Content-Length in place of the counter.
Stop when one response or the cumulative total exceeds its cap.
Do not assume a non-layer body occupies the full cap.
